title: FAA UAP reports, batch 09 (237UAP00208 - 237UAP00233)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA Skywatch incident reports; one report contains a close-approach encounter involving a civilian report of a hovering object.

encounters.summary: Frederick County Sheriff Office reported a lighted object the size of a car hovering over a truck near Point of Rocks, MD.
encounters.quote: lighted object the size of a car hovering over their truck
